name: marqvisibilidad
description: Estudio MARQ: sitio público, mapa 3D y CRM MARQ Contigo (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL).

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @marq/shared && npm run build -w @marq/map3d
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @marq/api && npm run build -w @marq/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
